title: RingedExtendedCech
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings. Use its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For global sections $f_1,\ldots,f_r$, construct the augmented extended Cech complex as the ordered total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] of the two-term complexes $[\mathcal O\to\mathcal O[1/f_i]]$ in degrees zero and one, with localizations and their maps from [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization]. Use the additive closed tensor structure of [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Each factor is augmented to $\mathcal O[0]$ by identity in degree zero and zero elsewhere; tensor these augmentations and use the unit isomorphisms. The empty tensor is $\mathcal O[0]$ with identity augmentation. Under the canonical localization tensor identifications, degree $q$ is the finite product over $q$-element subsets of $\mathcal O[1/\prod_{i\in S}f_i]$; the tensor differential is the alternating sum of localization maps.
